annotations.title: Find failure precedents for a design

description: Profile a proposed feature, system or AI-agent workflow and return documented incidents from systems that behaved similarly, their failure patterns, and the safeguards to build in. Use before writing code for anything that moves money, deletes data, changes permissions, runs code, or acts on external content.

proposal.description: Two to five sentences: what the system does, what it can change, what data it reads, which services it calls.

name: analyze_design
title: Find failure precedents for a design
